stackRecipes.name: Local private RAG — minimal
stackRecipes.goal: Private document Q&A with minimal operations.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Fastest local setup; embedded retrieval limits horizontal scale.

stackRecipes.name: Local private RAG — balanced
stackRecipes.goal: A prototype that can grow into multi-user deployment.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Stronger retrieval and operations, with more moving parts.

stackRecipes.name: Knowledge product — engineering balanced
stackRecipes.goal: Document ingestion, retrieval and agent/application layer.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Good composability; requires explicit integration choices.

stackRecipes.name: Coding Agent delivery loop — controlled
stackRecipes.goal: Policy-controlled coding agent with tests and human approval.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: More reliable autonomy, at the cost of orchestration and policy work.

stackRecipes.name: Business automation MVP
stackRecipes.goal: Connect workflows, CRM and support without building every subsystem.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Very fast MVP assembly; integration boundaries become the main architecture concern.

stackRecipes.name: Voice agent MVP
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Realtime latency and provider choice dominate architecture.

stackRecipes.name: Browser agent MVP
stackRecipes.goal: Automate browser workflows with an agent.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Untrusted web content and tool permissions require strong safeguards.

stackRecipes.name: AI SaaS MVP — TypeScript
stackRecipes.goal: Ship a web AI product with a pragmatic reusable stack.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Optimized for time-to-product; hosted payment/auth choices may still be external.

stackRecipes.name: General agent MVP — tool using
stackRecipes.goal: Build a tool-using agent without assembling a custom runtime from scratch.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Fast path to useful agency; tool permissions and state management still need explicit design.

stackRecipes.name: Local / offline AI — portable CPU
stackRecipes.goal: Private local assistant or prototype without mandatory cloud inference.
stackRecipes.tradeoff: Privacy and portability are strong; model size, RAM and latency become first-order constraints.
